tasks.title: Shape the JS Practice Loop product and foundation
acceptance: one target user and one learning problem are explicit
the first useful flow is bounded
non-goals prevent course-platform and AI-tutor expansion
frontend, storage, testing, auth, backend, design and architecture decisions are recorded with minimal scope

tasks.title: Create and persist one JavaScript practice attempt
scope: empty state with one Create attempt action
form fields for title, exercise prompt, optional source, learner attempt and solved/stuck status
saved attempt survives a full page reload
outOfScope: accounts, backend, database, sync or deployment
component libraries and broad design systems
acceptance: a learner can create one attempt using only required fields
invalid required fields show clear inline feedback
saved data is written through the storage boundary rather than directly by UI components
the attempt appears in the recent list
the same attempt reappears after a full page reload
no answer, hint or executable code feature is present
the layout is usable at a 390 pixel viewport
requiredEvidence: unit tests for validation and storage serialization
mobile screenshot of empty and saved states
final diff review proving no backend, auth, AI or code-runner scope

tasks.title: Record the mistake and lesson learned
acceptance: the learner can add what was wrong and what they learned
reflection remains editable
existing attempts migrate or load safely
requiredEvidence: browser flow from saved attempt to reflection

tasks.title: Retry a due mistake without showing the previous answer first
acceptance: the learner can mark an item for review
a due item asks for a fresh attempt before revealing prior reflection
review timing remains simple and explainable
requiredEvidence: owner decision on manual versus fixed review intervals

tasks.title: Show a small history of repeated mistakes
acceptance: the learner can see attempts grouped by a small explicit mistake label
history is factual and avoids scores or unsupported learning claims
requiredEvidence: evidence from at least five real exercises

tasks.title: Export and restore a local backup
acceptance: the learner can export versioned JSON
a valid backup restores attempts without duplicates
invalid or incompatible files fail safely
